mentions.name: SeniorDev
mentions.description: This cloud-based coding agent connects to an existing GitHub repo, spins up a feature branch, commits incremental changes, and opens a pull request. It provides an embedded VS Code server so users can review and tweak the code before merging, with no local setup needed.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on yet another cloud based coding agent https://seniordev.io/ that connects to an existing GitHub repo, spins up a feature branch, commits incremental changes, and opens a PR. You can jump into an embedded VS Code server to review and tweak the code before merging—no local setup needed.
